source.section: Skill Category Bonuses (Option) -- 'Skill Category Modifiers' and 'Skill Bonus Table'
source.notes: Primary: +/-1% per point from 10. Secondary: +/-1% per 2 points from 10, magnitude rounded down. Negative: inverted primary (subtracted). The category-to-characteristic map is the printed 'Skill Category Modifiers' table (p.18); Mental's second secondary is EDU per docs/decisions/0006-skill-bonus-system.md. Applied to the engine by docs/decisions/0022-skill-category-bonus-application.md; book-verified against tools/skill_bonus.py.
